purpose: Tag T3 antenna delay calibration, against T1 held FIXED at its already-calibrated 16428 (see ant_delay_tags_2026-09-21.json). Method changed from the T1/T4 pairing: there both sides were unknown and split 50/50; here T1 is a trusted reference, so the full correction is attributed to T3 alone -- pulling every subsequent tag into agreement with the same fixed point rather than letting the reference drift with each new pairing.
method: T3 temporarily role=RESP, slot_index=7 (unused), RESET to force live re-dispatch (SET,role+SAVE alone does not switch a running node -- role dispatch is boot-time only, per the spec's own state diagrams). T1 (0x8052) stayed INIT/frame_index 0, ant_delay untouched at 16428 throughout.

passes.note: residual was 2.5 SEM from zero, judged worth one more refinement

ANOMALY: a 2-DTU change should shift the mean by ~9.4mm, not 54mm. Re-measured over a longer 60s window (n=266) before reacting -- residual held stable at -39.18mm across four 15s chunks (1603.8/1586.2/1582.1/1591.2mm), rejecting equipment flakiness/transient movement as the cause. The single 40s pass-2 reading (+11.25mm) was concluded to have been the outlier, not pass 3.
correction computed from this larger, stability-confirmed sample instead of pass 2's single reading

caveats: The pass-3 anomaly is a genuine open question, not fully explained -- ruled out equipment/timing flakiness (stable over 60s) and ruled out my correction math (same formula that converged cleanly for T1/T4 and for this board's other four passes). Left as: a single 40s window is occasionally not enough to average out short-term multipath/geometry effects at this range; the fix applied was simply to trust a longer, re-confirmed sample over a shorter single one, not to add any new model term. Worth remembering when calibrating T2/T5/T6: verify a correction with a second independent measurement before calling it converged, not just one confirmation pass.
Same per-sample noise floor as the T1/T4 calibration (~55-65mm SD per line); the mean is reliable via SEM, individual $RNG lines are not.
